preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 6 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly two pairs of vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in output_pairs)
postconditions.description: Each pair of vertices consists of distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(x for x, y in output_pairs) | set(y for x, y in output_pairs)) == 4
postconditions.description: All four vertices in the two pairs are distinct.

postconditions.expression: not any(x in path(x2, y2) or y in path(x2, y2) for x, y in output_pairs) and not any(x in path(x1, y1) or y in path(x1, y1) for x, y in output_pairs)
postconditions.description: Neither pair's vertices are on the path of the other pair.
The number of common vertices between the two paths is at least 2.
The total length is the sum of the lengths of the two paths.

postconditions.expression: all(total_length >= path_length(x1, y1) + path_length(x2, y2) for (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in valid_pairs)
postconditions.description: The total length is maximized among all valid pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(len(common_vertices) <= len(common_vertices_max) for (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in valid_pairs)
postconditions.description: The number of common vertices is maximized among all pairs with the maximum total length.
